title.zh: 先固定能使用坐标展开的代数条件
title.en: Fix the hypotheses for the chart expansion

given.zh: $A$、$R$、$k$、$K$ 满足原声明中的代数塔、局部同态、形式无分歧、有限型与形式 étale 条件；$\sigma$ 有限，且每个 $a_i > 0$。
given.en: $A$, $R$, $k$ and $K$ satisfy the declared algebra towers, local-map, formally unramified, essentially finite-type and formally étale conditions; $\sigma$ is finite and every $a_i > 0$.

claim.zh: 要研究的是函数族 $w \mapsto (x \mapsto \mathrm{closedChartFieldRetraction}\,w\,x)$，参数取归一化截面 $\sum_i a_i w_i = 1$，并保留上述坐标图假设。
claim.en: The family is $w \mapsto (x \mapsto \mathrm{closedChartFieldRetraction}\,w\,x)$, restricted to $\sum_i a_i w_i = 1$; all the chart hypotheses remain part of the assertion.

reason.zh: 把题设的局部代数和形式 étale 条件代入 closedChartExpansion_injective；后面延拓到 $K$ 时正是用这份单射性排除非零元具有无限赋值。
reason.en: Apply closedChartExpansion_injective with the declared local-algebra and formally étale hypotheses. This injectivity makes the valuation finite on nonzero elements before extension to $K$.

reason.zh: 各项 $a_i w_i$ 都非负，所以每项不超过总和 $1$；再用 $a_i>0$ 除过去。这说明为什么严格正的归一化系数能限制每个权重。
reason.en: Every term $a_i w_i$ is nonnegative and therefore at most the sum, one. Divide by $a_i>0$. This explains why strict positivity bounds every coordinate.

statement.en: The target is compactness of $F(W_a)$, where $F(w)(x)=\mathrm{closedChartFieldRetraction}(w)(x)$.

reason.zh: 目标里的双函数依次取权重和分式域元素；把它看作函数空间中的映射，下一步就能使用“紧致集的连续像紧致”。
reason.en: The two function arguments are a weight and then a fraction-field element. Reading this as a map into a function space prepares the compact-image argument.

title.zh: 把单射坐标展开代入紧致性引理
title.en: Apply compactness to the injective coordinate expansion

given.zh: 取 $\theta = \mathrm{closedChartExpansion} : A \to_a[k] k\llbracket\sigma\rrbracket$，并使用已导入的 closedChartExpansion_injective。
given.en: Take $\theta = \mathrm{closedChartExpansion} : A \to_a[k] k\llbracket\sigma\rrbracket$ and the imported proof closedChartExpansion_injective.

claim.zh: 一般引理给出 $\{x \mapsto \mathrm{expandedFractionValuation}\,\theta\,h_\theta\,w\,x : w \in \mathrm{normalizedWeights}\,a\}$ 紧致。
claim.en: The general lemma yields compactness of $\{x \mapsto \mathrm{expandedFractionValuation}\,\theta\,h_\theta\,w\,x : w \in \mathrm{normalizedWeights}\,a\}$.

statement.zh: $W_a$ 是有限盒 $\prod_i [0,1/a_i]$ 中的闭集，因此紧致。
statement.en: $W_a$ is a closed subset of the finite box $\prod_i [0,1/a_i]$, hence compact.

reason.zh: 坐标上界来自前一步；$w\mapsto\sum_i a_i w_i$ 连续，所以取值为 $1$ 的截面闭。有限个闭有界区间的乘积紧致，闭子集仍紧致。
reason.en: The previous step bounds each coordinate. The continuous map $w\mapsto\sum_i a_i w_i$ has a closed level set at one. A finite product of compact intervals is compact, as is its closed subset.

statement.zh: 对非零 $p\in A$，$v_w(p)=\min_{d\in T_p}\sum_i w_i d_i$，其中 $T_p$ 有限。
statement.en: For nonzero $p\in A$, $v_w(p)=\min_{d\in T_p}\sum_i w_i d_i$ for a finite set $T_p$.

reason.zh: 库证明从 $\theta(p)$ 的支撑选出有限子集，使每个支撑指数都逐项大于等于其中某个指数。因 $w_i\ge 0$，剩余指数的权重不可能更小；有限个连续线性权重的最小值仍连续。
reason.en: The library selects a finite subset of the support of $\theta(p)$ such that every support exponent is at least one selected exponent in each coordinate. Nonnegative weights make the remaining weights no smaller; a finite minimum of continuous linear weights is continuous.

statement.zh: $w\mapsto V_w(x)$ 对每个 $x\in K$ 连续；$x=0$ 时恒为 $\top$。
statement.en: For each $x\in K$, $w\mapsto V_w(x)$ is continuous; for $x=0$ it is constantly $\top$.

reason.zh: 非零分式使用前一行的两个连续实函数之差；零分式单独使用常函数。逐点评价拓扑下，各坐标连续就给出整个函数族连续。
reason.en: For a nonzero fraction use the difference of two continuous real functions; handle zero as a constant function. Coordinatewise continuity gives continuity in the pointwise topology.

statement.zh: $W_a$ 紧致 $\Rightarrow \{V_w : w\in W_a\}$ 紧致。
statement.en: Compactness of $W_a$ implies compactness of $\{V_w : w\in W_a\}$.

reason.zh: 被调用的 isCompact_expandedFractionValuation_cone 正是把归一化截面的紧致性与这个连续映射相接，随后对 $\theta$ 和 $h_\theta$ 实例化。
reason.en: The invoked isCompact_expandedFractionValuation_cone takes the continuous image of the compact normalized section, instantiated at $\theta$ and $h_\theta$.

title.zh: 展开三个定义，得到原结论
title.en: Unfold three definitions to obtain the target

given.zh: 上一步已得到展开赋值在分式域 $K$ 上的紧致函数族。
given.en: The preceding step gives a compact family of expanded valuations on $K$.

claim.zh: 这恰好是 $\{x \mapsto \mathrm{closedChartFieldRetraction}\,w\,x : w \in \mathrm{normalizedWeights}\,a\}$，因此目标中的 IsCompact 成立。
claim.en: This is exactly $\{x \mapsto \mathrm{closedChartFieldRetraction}\,w\,x : w \in \mathrm{normalizedWeights}\,a\}$, so the required IsCompact statement follows.

reason.zh: 展开局部回缩的定义后，就是沿选定坐标展开 $\theta$ 拉回的单项式赋值；参数 $w$ 没有发生变换。
reason.en: Unfolding the local retraction gives the monomial valuation pulled back along $\theta$, with the same weight $w$.

reason.zh: 两者再用同一个 fractionValuation 将上一行的局部赋值延拓到 $K$。最终的 simpa only 只展开这三个定义。
reason.en: Both apply the same fractionValuation construction to extend that local valuation to $K$. The final simpa only unfolds precisely these definitions.

reason.zh: 逐点相等使两组像集相同，因此上一步的紧致集就是原目标中的集合。
reason.en: Pointwise equality identifies the image sets, so the compact set from the preceding step is exactly the set in the target.
